highlights: **Privacy after-party — no new upstream commits:** This fork-only release removes outbound product analytics, analytics identity collection, agent-feedback uploads, relay diagnostic exports, and OpenTelemetry exports and endpoint probes. Saved settings and environment overrides cannot turn these senders back on.

**Mobile and SDK reporting:** New Android builds omit the crash/startup upload SDK. Clerk telemetry is disabled across web, desktop and mobile, and repository-owned build/cache summary uploads are removed without disabling functional artifact caching.

**Local diagnostics stay local:** Resource monitoring, CPU/memory history, local logs and local Traces remain available through your authenticated connections. Provider requests, sign-in, updates, remote connections and enabled notification/activity publishing still use the network for their features; independently installed tools and remote services have their own privacy controls.

**Activation matters:** Publishing does not change already-running apps or servers, and cannot retract previously sent data. Desktop updates and server activation remain in the existing UI; the Android preview is delivered separately for an in-place phone update.
